figures.caption: Table 1: Comparison of representative multi-view resources for MLLMs. MV denotes multi-view input, Corr. denotes explicit cross-view correspondence supervision, and Scene-disj. denotes a scene-disjoint train/eval split. In the Role column, D and B indicate dataset and benchmark, respectively. The symbol ◦ denotes partial support.
Table 2: Question taxonomy of CrossViewSet and CrossViewBench.
Figure 3: Overview of CrossViewer. Stage I extracts mask-grounded object tokens, Stage II aligns them across views, and Stage III performs region-guided reasoning.
Table 3: Performance comparisons on CrossViewBench. The best results are bold and the second-best results are underlined.
Figure 4: Overview panels of CrossView Suite and CrossViewer: per-type gains, gap to HumanBase, and t-SNE of Q1 correspondence embeddings before and after training.
